title: Saita WhatsApp lafiya kuma ku kulle asusunku

say: Saita WhatsApp lafiya, kuma ku kulle asusunku.
Wannan shine bidiyon module na daya na WhatsApp don Sadarwa da Kasuwanci.
An danganta asusun WhatsApp ɗinku zuwa lambar waya ɗaya. Wannan lambar ta zama ainihin ku, don haka zaɓi layin da kuke shirin kiyayewa na shekaru.
Da farko, shigar da ainihin app, kuma babu wani abu.

say: Na gaba, zaku ga dalilin da yasa lambar lambobi shida da ta zo ta SMS ba zata taɓa barin hannunku ba.

say: Kawai shigar da WhatsApp daga Google Play Store akan Android, ko App Store akan iPhone. Bincika cewa mai haɓakawa shine WhatsApp LLC.
Ci gaba da sabunta shi don gyaran tsaro.

panel.heading: Aikace-aikacen hukuma ko tarko?
left: Google Play Store ko App Store

say: Kar a taɓa shigar da kwafin da aka kewaya azaman fayiloli, kamar GB WhatsApp. Ba WhatsApp ne ke yin su ba, suna iya satar sakonninku, kuma WhatsApp na iya hana asusu masu amfani da su.
Idan kana da ɗaya, yi ajiyar abin da kuke buƙata, cire shi, kuma shigar da aikace-aikacen hukuma.

panel.heading: Aikace-aikacen hukuma ko tarko?
left: Google Play Store ko App Store

say: Tabbacin mataki biyu yana ƙara PIN mai lamba shida da ka ƙirƙira. Sannan duk wanda ke kokarin yin rijistar lambar ku a wata sabuwar wayar yana bukatar lambar SMS da PIN din ku.
Mataki na daya. Bude Settings, sannan Account, sannan tabbatarwa ta mataki biyu.

say: Mataki na biyu. Matsa Kunna kuma buga PIN mai lamba shida za ku tuna. Kar a yi amfani da ranar haihuwar ku, 123456, ko PIN ɗin ku na ATM.

say: Mataki na biyar. Rubuta PIN a wani wuri mai aminci a gida, ba cikin bayanan wayar ku ba.
Kuma ku tuna mulkin. Lambar SMS ɗinku kamar PIN ɗin ATM ɗinku ne. WhatsApp ba zai taba kira ko aika sakon ku don neman shi ba.

say: Ga yadda dabara ke aiki. Chioma a Owerri yana sayar da kayan gashi. Wata rana da yamma sako ya fito daga asusun kawunta.
Yana cewa, nayi kuskure na tura code dina zuwa ga lambarka, don Allah ka aiko min.

panel.heading: A kusa miss: da code dabara
items: Sako daga asusun dan uwanta na neman code
Lambar SMS tana zuwa a lokaci guda
Ba ta aika shi; ta kira dan uwanta
Ta kunna tabbatarwa mataki biyu

say: A lokaci guda, SMS mai lamba shida ya zo. Chioma ta gane tsarin. Wani ne ke kokarin yin rijistar lambar ta a wata wayar, kuma da alama an riga an sace asusun dan uwanta.
